mapper.select: SELECT id FROM spot WHERE name = #{name} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spot ( name, theme, latitude, longitude, verification_status, enabled, source_name, source_reference, usage_rights_note, verified_at, theme_fit_score, scenic_quality_score, route_suitability_score, quality_review_note ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{theme}::varchar, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{verificationStatus}::varchar, #{enabled}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceReference}, #{usageRightsNote}, #{verifiedAt}, #{themeFitScore}, #{scenicQualityScore}, #{routeSuitabilityScore}, #{qualityReviewNote} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, theme, latitude, longitude FROM spot WHERE theme = #{theme}::varchar AND verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND enabled = TRUE AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(source_name), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(source_reference), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(usage_rights_note), '') IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND theme_fit_score BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND scenic_quality_score BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND route_suitability_score BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND NULLIF(BTRIM(quality_review_note), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (theme_fit_score + scenic_quality_score + route_suitability_score) DESC, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT theme FROM spot WHERE verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND enabled = TRUE AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(source_name), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(source_reference), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(usage_rights_note), '') IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND theme_fit_score BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND scenic_quality_score BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND route_suitability_score BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND NULLIF(BTRIM(quality_review_note), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY theme
